title: feat(search): Unicode-safe fuzzy matching with preview UI
body:
<!--
feat(search): Unicode-safe fuzzy matching with preview UI
-->
## Summary / 摘要

Implements fzf-style fuzzy subsequence matching for the search plugin — code-point aware, zero-dependency, fully tested — and surfaces it in the electron-demo search bar with a live match preview.

为 search 插件实现 fzf 风格的模糊子序列匹配：码点感知（emoji/CJK 安全）、零依赖、测试完备，并在 electron-demo 搜索栏中提供可视化匹配预览。

## Motivation / 背景与动机

Literal search forces users to remember exact wording; fuzzy subsequence matching lets them type `fzs` and find `fuzzy search` — the lookup style users expect from VS Code / fzf / Obsidian Quick Switcher. This matters for a Markdown-native editor whose users live in large note vaults.

精确匹配要求用户记住原文措辞；模糊子序列匹配允许输入 `fzs` 命中 `fuzzy search`，这是用户在 VS Code / fzf / Obsidian 中习惯的查找方式。对面向大型笔记库的 Markdown 编辑器而言，这是查找体验的基础能力。

- Issue: —
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): **#17 Fuzzy search** (`plugin-search`, P2)
- OpenSpec change: — (additive plugin API + demo integration; no breaking change, per CONTRIBUTING §3.1)

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-search`:
  - New `fuzzy.ts`: greedy subsequence matcher with position scoring (word-boundary bonus +10, consecutive-run bonus +15*run, gap penalty -3/char). Exported as pure functions `fuzzyMatch` / `findFuzzyMatches` alongside `FuzzyMatch` / `FuzzySearchOptions` types.
  - `SearchOptions.fuzzy` / `fuzzyMaxGap` wire fuzzy mode into the existing `findSearchMatches` / `replaceAllMatches` — mutually exclusive with `regexp` / `wholeWord`.
  - **Code-point aware matching**: comparison and cursor advancement operate on whole code points, so an emoji in the query actually matches (previously impossible because `text[i]` splits surrogate pairs), positions never land inside a surrogate pair, and `maxGap` / gap penalties are measured in code points rather than code units. Returned offsets stay in UTF-16 code units, matching editor selection coordinates (CodeMirror, Monaco, textarea), so callers can feed `from`/`to`/`positions` straight into selection and highlight APIs.
  - Emoji count as word boundaries (`\p{S}`), so `👋hello` scores `hello` at a boundary.
- `apps/electron-demo`:
  - Search bar gains an **Fz toggle** (or `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F`) switching to fuzzy subsequence matching; replace-all honours the active mode.
  - **Match preview row** renders the current match window with every matched character `<mark>`-ed, plus the match score and offsets — subsequence matching becomes visible instead of magic.
  - Search input is **debounced (80 ms)** so re-searching never blocks a keystroke.
- `packages/core`: — (no changes)
- `openspec/`: — (not required; see above)

## Performance / 性能

Measured on this branch (Node 22, Windows x64), scanning a **169,000-character** document:

| Operation | Time | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `findFuzzyMatches("fzs")` | **14.0 ms** | 2,999 matches |
| `findFuzzyMatches("qux")` | 9.7 ms | 3,000 matches |
| `findFuzzyMatches("👋")` | 13.1 ms | 1,000 matches |
| `fuzzyMatch("fzs")` (best-match scan) | 12.2 ms | — |

A full-document fuzzy scan fits inside one 60 fps frame budget (16.7 ms); combined with the 80 ms input debounce in the demo, typing stays at full frame rate even on ~170k-char documents. Zero runtime dependencies added — bundle delta is the matcher itself (~3 KB min).

全文模糊扫描单帧预算（16.7ms）内完成；配合 demo 中 80ms 输入防抖，约 17 万字符文档上输入保持满帧。零新增运行时依赖，包体积增量仅匹配器本身（约 3 KB min）。

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 — 615 tests, 37 files (was 556 on base: +59 matcher and integration tests in the first commit, +20 here)
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过 — `nexus-plugin-search` (ESM+DTS) and `nexus-electron-demo` (vite) both green; `pnpm typecheck` clean
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：
  - `packages/plugin-search/test/fuzzy.test.ts` — 12 Unicode cases: emoji/CJK matching, surrogate-pair safety, astral case folding (Deseret U+10400->U+10428), emoji as word boundary, code-point gap measurement
  - `packages/plugin-search/test/search.test.ts` — fuzzy option integration with literal/regexp/wholeWord modes *(first commit)*
  - `apps/electron-demo/test/search-bar.test.ts` — 8 integration cases driving the bar against a real editor: visibility, literal vs fuzzy behaviour, preview `<mark>` rendering, mode switching, fuzzy replace-all
- [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证：open demo -> `Ctrl+Shift+F` -> type `fzs` -> matched characters highlight in the preview row; `↑`/`↓` navigates matches; `All` replaces fuzzy matches.（截图见下方）

- [x] **New dependencies** (if any) listed with license and rationale: **none / 无新增依赖**
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed (`dist/`, `dist-electron/`, compiled `.js` from `.ts`) / 未提交构建产物

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits / 标题遵循 Conventional Commits — `feat(search): ...`
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — new exports carry full JSDoc types; matching semantics documented in `fuzzy.ts` header

## Screenshots / Recordings

Electron demo verified locally: `Ctrl+Shift+F` -> type `fzs` -> matched characters highlight in preview row.

commits_at_first_review.message:
feat(search): add fuzzy subsequence matching with scoring

Implements ROADMAP #17 — fuzzy search for the search plugin.

- Add fuzzy.ts: greedy subsequence matcher with position scoring
  (word-boundary bonus, consecutive-run bonus, gap penalty)
- Export fuzzyMatch / findFuzzyMatches as standalone pure functions
- Integrate fuzzy mode into findSearchMatches / replaceAllMatches
  via a new `fuzzy` option on SearchOptions
- Add 59 tests covering algorithm correctness, edge cases, and
  integration with existing literal/regexp/wholeWord modes

The search plugin previously had no dedicated unit tests for
findSearchMatches / replaceAllMatches; this PR also fills that gap.

feat(search): make fuzzy matching code-point aware

Astral-plane characters (emoji, CJK extension blocks, musical
symbols) span two UTF-16 code units, and the matcher previously
indexed text by code unit — so an emoji in the query could never
match, positions could land inside a surrogate pair, and gaps
containing astral characters were priced double.

- Compare and advance by whole code points in greedyMatch and the
  scan loops; returned offsets stay in UTF-16 code units to match
  editor selection coordinates (CodeMirror, Monaco, textarea)
- Treat emoji as word boundaries by testing the full previous code
  point, so "👋hello" scores "hello" at a boundary
- Measure maxGap and gap penalties in code points, not code units
- Add 12 tests covering emoji/CJK matching, surrogate-pair safety,
  astral case folding, and boundary scoring

feat(electron): add fuzzy search mode with match preview

Surfaces the fuzzy matcher in the demo app so the feature is
verifiable by hand, and keeps typing responsive on large documents.

- Fz toggle (or Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F) switches the search bar to fuzzy
  subsequence matching; replace-all honours the active mode
- Preview row renders the current match window with every matched
  character marked, plus the match score and offsets — subsequence
  matching becomes visible instead of magic
- Search input is debounced (80ms) so re-searching never blocks a
  keystroke; a full fuzzy scan of a 169k-char doc measures ~14ms,
  inside one frame budget
- Add 8 integration tests driving the bar against a real editor
